import re

BANNER = re.compile(r"^=+ (?P<title>.+?) =+$")
SUMMARY = re.compile(r"^=+ (?P<counts>.+?) in (?P<duration>[\d.]+s) =+$")
SESSION = re.compile(r"^(?P<key>platform|rootdir|configfile|cachedir|plugins|collected)(?::| ) ?(?P<value>\S.*?)(?: items?)?\s*$")
PROGRESS = re.compile(r"^(?P<file>\S+) (?P<results>[.FEsxX]+)\s+\[\s*(?P<percent>\d+%)\]$")
RESULT = re.compile(r"^(?P<outcome>PASSED|FAILED|ERROR|SKIPPED|XFAIL|XPASS)(?: \[(?P<count>\d+)\])? (?P<test>\S+?):?(?:(?: -)? (?P<message>\S.*?))?\s*$")
TESTHDR = re.compile(r"^_+ (?P<test>\S.*?) _+$")
CAPTURED = re.compile(r"^-+ Captured (?P<stream>\w+) (?P<phase>\w+) -+$")
ERRLINE = re.compile(r"^E\s+(?P<error>\S.*?)\s*$")
LOCATION = re.compile(r"^(?P<file>\S+):(?P<line>\d+): (?P<exception>\S.*?)\s*$")
SOURCE = re.compile(r"^(?P<marker>>)?\s{3,}(?P<code>\S.*?)\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    session, l_sess = {}, []
    progress, l_prog, results, l_res, tests, l_tests, captured, l_cap, skip = [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], []
    section, test, cap = "", None, None
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = SUMMARY.match(ln)
        if m:
            for part in m.group("counts").split(","):
                n, _, what = part.strip().partition(" ")
                session[what] = n
            session["duration"] = m.group("duration")
            l_sess.append(j)
            continue
        m = BANNER.match(ln)
        if m:
            section = m.group("title")
            test, cap = None, None
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        m = TESTHDR.match(ln)
        if m:
            test = {"section": section, "test": m.group("test"), "file": "", "line": "",
                    "exception": "", "failing_line": "", "error": "", "source": ""}
            tests.append(test)
            l_tests.append(j)
            cap = None
            continue
        m = CAPTURED.match(ln)
        if m and test is not None:
            cap = {"stream": m.group("stream"), "phase": m.group("phase")}
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        if cap is not None:
            captured.append({"section": section, "test": test["test"], "stream": cap["stream"],
                             "phase": cap["phase"], "text": ln.rstrip()})
            l_cap.append(j)
            continue
        m = SESSION.match(ln)
        if m and test is None:
            session[m.group("key")] = m.group("value")
            l_sess.append(j)
            continue
        m = PROGRESS.match(ln)
        if m:
            progress.append({"file": m.group("file"), "results": m.group("results"),
                             "percent": m.group("percent")})
            l_prog.append(j)
            continue
        m = RESULT.match(ln)
        if m:
            results.append({"outcome": m.group("outcome"), "count": m.group("count") or "",
                            "test": m.group("test"), "message": m.group("message") or ""})
            l_res.append(j)
            continue
        if test is None:
            continue
        m = ERRLINE.match(ln)
        if m:
            test["error"] = (test["error"] + " " + m.group("error")).strip()
            l_tests.append(j)
            continue
        m = LOCATION.match(ln)
        if m:
            test["file"], test["line"], test["exception"] = m.group("file"), m.group("line"), m.group("exception")
            l_tests.append(j)
            continue
        m = SOURCE.match(ln)
        if m:
            if m.group("marker"):
                test["failing_line"] = m.group("code")
            test["source"] = (test["source"] + " | " + m.group("code")).strip(" |")
            l_tests.append(j)
    blocks = [{"name": "session", "kind": "kv", "lines": l_sess, "records": [session]},
              {"name": "progress", "kind": "table", "lines": l_prog, "records": progress},
              {"name": "tests", "kind": "table", "lines": l_tests, "records": tests},
              {"name": "captured", "kind": "table", "lines": l_cap, "records": captured},
              {"name": "results", "kind": "table", "lines": l_res, "records": results}]
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": skip}
